content: Komaakciŋ ngo, mi yii fiis ɗu in ceem ne ɗu bakaaɗuu. Waaye yino nga ɓoo bakaaɗ ɗah, ɓoo raakiɗ Yi ngelɗan ɓoo ŋ fiki Baabi, a Yeesu Kiristaa, Yurhiɗi.
Laam, a yi eɗoh haf ce ne a seeƴkohu wuu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo, te wa wuu ɓoo dong haa waaye wuu ɓi Adina jen.
Nakohi asi
Ini na teeɓe ɓoo ne ɓoo inhiɗ Heɗi, weɗ ne ɓoo taambiɗ nakoh ciŋ ɗe.
Yi na woye ne a inhiɗ Kooh, te a taambiɗɗi nakoh ciŋ ɗe, yeem leyoh te keeh ki nikɗi nga ɗe.
Waaye ɓoyi na taambɗe woo kiŋ ɗe, waaɗi a waaɗ Kooh na nike mitiɗ sik te wa nik keeh nga ɗe - ŋ ineem ɓoo inah ne ɓoo ɓii ŋ Kooh.
Yaa nu woo ne a yii ŋ Kooh ɗah, a joy pesoh findi Yeesu pesohe.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, wa nakoh as weɗ maa fiisee ɗu haa, wa nakoh maañiɗ te ɗu rahasa wa wa camb, te nakoheem, e woo ki ɗu kerah.
Moona ini maa fiisee ɗu, wa nakoh as keeh-keeh ŋ kipes kiŋ Kiristaani, findi wa nam nikoh as keeh-keeh ŋ kipes kiŋ ɗu, ñuusi wa ɗii coot te siñaari siñaarɗiɗ po ƴutiɗ.
Yi na woye ne a yii ŋ siñaari te a waaɗɗi yi a ɓaah na ɗe kos, a ris ŋ ñuusi poyi.
Ɓi waaɗ ɓaah ciŋ ɓa kosiɗ ci, ɓa gen ŋ siñaari te ali in kafndanɗi ɓa.
Waaye ɓi waaɗɗi ɓaah ciŋ ɓa, ɓa ɗi ŋ ñuusi ; ɓa na tiinde ŋ ɗooƴ ñuusi te ɓa inahɗi ɗiski ɓa na kaɗe, ñuusi fuulɗiɗ has ciŋ ɓa.
Ɓo' nu waaɗ Adina ɗah, waaɗɗi Baabi

content.text: Mi yii fiis ɗu, baab ci :
Ɗu inhiɗ Yi nik ŋ camba poyi.

woo kiŋ Kooh gen nga ɗu

content: Kinaat waaɗ Adina na in ci nik ŋ ɗooƴ Adina. Ɓo' waaɗ Adina ɗah, waaɗ Baabi nikɗi nga ɗe.
In ci nik ŋ Adina jen, findi taambiɗ kiñin, maɗ in ci has na hote, na yaksiɗuk ŋ raak-raak, ceem jen ca ina Baabi haa, ca ina Adina.
Te kat, Adina na reehe reeh na in ci na maɗse nga, waaye yi na tume ini Kooh waaɗ genan gen po faw.
Sangiɗ ciŋ Kiristaani
Kuɓuuciŋ ngo, ɓoo ɓii ŋ jamanooci mirndoh. Ɗu kerhiɗ ne sangiɗiŋ Kiristaani yii hay, te woti-woti, sangiɗ ciŋ Kiristaani laayiɗ, tahha po ɓoo inhiɗ ne ɓoo ɓii ŋ jamanooci mirndoh.
Ɓa puliɗ nga ɓoo waaye ɓa ɓaaheeɗi nga ɓoo ; laam ɓa ɓaaheen nga ɓoo ɗah, ɓa heen rise na ɓoo. Waaye ineem teeɓohiɗ ne ali yino nga ɓa ɓaahɗi nga ɓoo.
Ɗu nak, ɗu rahsiɗ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, tahha po ɗu jen ɗu inhiɗ keeh ki ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kooh.
Mi yii fiis ɗu, wa nikɗi haa ne ɗu inahɗi keeh ki, waaye ɗu inhiɗa te ɗu inhiɗ ne ali lee na puloheeɗi ŋ keeh.
Ya ɓa leyohi ? E yi taas ne Yeesu a yi Kiristaani
. Yeem, a yi sangiɗiŋ Kiristaani, yi taas Baabi na Kuɓki.
Yaa nu taasuk Kuɓki ɗah, a namɗi raak Baabi. Yaa nu teyɗuk Kuɓki ɗah, a namiɗ raak Baabi.
Ini ɗu kerah ŋ camba poyi, risaat nga ɗu. Ini ɗu kerah ŋ camba poyi ris nga ɗu ɗah, ɗu naman ris ŋ Kuɓki na Baabi.
Te ini a gap ɓoo, weɗ kipes ki heyɗi reehe.
Ineem weɗ ŋ waaɗee ɗu fiis ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓi na muuƴɗee ɗu.

Ini kaɗ nga ɗu, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɗu rahsoh nga ɗe hey gene nga ɗu, te ɗu etohɗi ɓo' wiiriis jangɗee ɗu ; Fuuɗsi yii jangiɗ ɗu in ci jen, te ini a na jangɗee ɗu wa keeh te wa lee haa, mbaa risaat ŋ Kiristaani, findi Fuuɗsi jangɗoh ɗu.
Kuɓuuciŋ Kooh na bakaaɗeeɗi
Ɗiski wa nik, kuɓuuciŋ ngo, risaat ŋ Kiristaani, po mbeha a teeɓkohan, wa raak ɓoo riifiɗ na ooluk, ɓoo raakuu kaci ŋ fikiice ne a hay ɗah.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne a yurhiɗ ɗah, ɗu namiɗ inah ne ɓo' nu na pese ŋ yurah ɗah, a rimkoh nga ɗe.

footnotes.text: Ŋ jamanoonaam, raakiɗ ɓi teyɗukee ne Kiristaani nikee Kuɓkiŋ Kooh, a hay hay ŋ Adina, waaye a nikeeɗi ɓo' njaay findi ɓoo, a nikee puuɗis, a aassa ɓo' njaay teeku Yeesu. Kon nga ɓa Yeesu pulohɗi Eel ci, a hayɗi Adina, te a nikeeɗi Kiristaani, a nikeeɗi Kuɓkiŋ Kooh. Saaŋ woo ndii ne ɓo' nu woo ineem ɗah, a leyoh, te ngaŋ saar 4, aaya 3, a woo ne ɓoyeem, liiɓ ciŋ ɗe, ca liiɓ ciŋ sangiɗiŋ Kiristaani. Nama marak saar 4, aaya 15 na saar 5, aaya 1.
